title: game/objectives/<id>.json
description: One objective of the session (CONTENT_PLAN 3.5, C07). Loaded by ObjectiveBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core). A checklist has a title and its steps name nouns; another objective is shown by its objective.<id>.hud line. An order (VILLAGE_PLAN V03) names the NPC the goods are brought to (deliverTo) and the goods (deliver), and has no title and no steps: its one step, delivered, waits for order_delivered at that NPC with the objective's id.

event.description: The event waited for: a world event (WorldEvents), or for a tip start or aimed_npc.

npc.description: The NPC the event must be about (an agent id).

detail.description: The detail the event must have, exactly (item_picked_up and item_crafted: the id of the noun (wood, fruit); torch_at_ring: the ring's name).

trigger.description: What the step or tip waits for (CONTENT_PLAN C06).

item.description: An item by the name the save gives it (ItemDefinition).

id.description: The objective's id, the file's name.

title.description: The target-language title of a checklist (Campamento).

id.description: The step's id; the save keys it <objective>.<step>.

noun.description: For a checklist step: the id of the catalogue noun it is about (wood, fruit).

label.description: The word the checklist shows, when the noun's lemma or plural is not it.

restore.description: The code hook that works the step out again from a loaded world; the save does not keep the step.

alsoDoneBy.description: The objectives whose progress also completes this one.

onComplete.description: The code hooks run when the objective is completed.

session.description: The play session the objective is shown and counted from (V03); before it the HUD hides it and its steps count nothing. Every session when left out.

deliverTo.description: An order (V03): the NPC the goods are brought to. When the talk opens on it with the goods in the inventory, the NPC takes them, says <npc>.delivered (its thanks; the reward is that line's give_item), order_delivered is logged and the objective is done.

deliver.description: An order's goods: each item (by the name the save gives it) once, and how many.

lesson.description: An order (V13): the lesson that tells it in the three times, with a do step that waits for its delivery. While that lesson is under way before the step, or is about to start at the order's NPC, walking up with the goods does not deliver them, so the plan comes first even for a learner who carries them already.
